{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool blazer, structured fit, knee-length hem, charcoal gray (#3b424c), tweed weave
Cashmere turtleneck sweater, slim silhouette, hip-length body, navy blue (#0a1f45), soft knit
Straight-leg dark denim trousers, ankle-grazing length, black wash (#0d0e10), rigid cotton denim
Leather ankle boots with a low heel, straight shaft, black color (#1a1816), smooth grain finish
Satin studded belt, thin waistband, black leather (#2c2420), metallic hardware accents
This outfit works because it balances the professionalism required for a business meeting with the warmth needed against -10°C temperatures and snow. The wool blazer provides essential insulation while maintaining a sharp silhouette suitable for an autumn daywalk to work. Darker tones like navy and black offer both practicality against the elements and a polished look appropriate for formal daytime settings, ensuring you stay dry and composed without sacrificing style."}
